dedupe_keys.name: hourly anomaly scores and leak labels from a multi source urban water distribution network dataset

description: Hourly Anomaly Scores and Leak Labels from a Multi-Source Urban Water Distribution Network Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Babela Jan, Michal Munk (Constantine the Philosopher University in Nitra). Dataset: Hourly Anomaly Scores and Leak Labels from a Multi-Source Urban Water Distribution Network Dataset Description:This dataset includes hourly time series from an anonymized urban Water Distribution Network (WDN), combining SCADA sensor readings, operational energy usage, and environmental conditions. Anomaly scores were generated using Elastic ML and Isolation Forest. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
